title: Google Search
description: Collect web evidence for an AI agent with Google result titles, snippets and source URLs. Snippets are not full page content.
output: results[0].organic contains titles, links, snippets and positions when available. Keep the links with any downstream research notes.

title: Google News
description: Monitor a company or topic with Google News headlines and source links for a daily briefing. Does not retrieve article full text.
output: results[0].news contains headlines, links and available publisher, date and snippet fields. Dates may be relative.

title: Google Images
description: Build an image-reference shortlist with original image URLs, thumbnails and source pages. Does not download or license images.
output: results[0].images contains imageUrl, link and available thumbnail and dimension fields. Review licensing on the source page before reuse.

title: Google Shopping
description: Collect product listings for a buying comparison, with available merchant and price fields. Search snapshots do not guarantee stock or checkout prices.
output: results[0].shopping contains product titles, links and available price, merchant, rating and delivery fields.

title: Google Video Search
description: Find videos across websites for a research shortlist, with links and available duration and publisher fields. Does not download video files.
output: results[0].videos contains titles, links and available snippets, durations, channels and dates. This is Google video search, distinct from YouTube-only search.

title: Google Places
description: Build a local-business shortlist from a category and location, with available addresses, ratings and contact details. Some fields may be absent.
output: results[0].places contains business titles and available address, coordinates, website, phone and rating fields.

title: YouTube Search
description: Discover a small set of YouTube videos for a research workflow. Request 1–20 results; actual count can be lower.
output: results[0].results contains video IDs, titles and available channel, duration, view-count and thumbnail fields. Use videoId in a separate metadata or transcript step.

title: YouTube Extended Search
description: Collect a larger YouTube candidate set for downstream research filtering. Request 1–700 results, with a separate rate from standard search; actual count varies.
output: results[0].results contains video discovery data; results[0].totalResults reports the returned count. The 700 ceiling is not a result-count guarantee.

title: YouTube Metadata
description: Enrich a known video ID with metadata and available chapters or format information before choosing research sources. Does not download media.
output: results[0] contains video and channel details, counts, thumbnails and requested formats/chapters when available. Missing counts can be null.

title: YouTube Transcript
description: Read an existing transcript for timestamped notes. Defaults to English automatic captions; no ASR, translation or fallback to another caption track.
output: results[0].segments contains start, end and text; results[0].fullText contains joined text. The selected language and caption type must exist.

title: YouTube Captions
description: Read existing uploader-provided captions for editorial review. Defaults to English manual captions; no ASR, translation or automatic fallback.
output: results[0].segments and fullText contain the selected captions with language/type metadata. This returns JSON text, not a direct SRT/VTT export.

title: YouTube License Metadata
description: Record a video's Creative Commons license label for a separate rights review. This does not grant training rights or retrieve creator third-party training settings.
output: results[0].permitted reports ["all"] when a Creative Commons label is detected, otherwise ["none"], including missing metadata. These values do not establish permission to train.

title: YouTube Channel
description: Snapshot a channel profile and recent videos for monitoring. Request 1–100 recent videos (default 20); statistics and videos may be unavailable.
output: results[0] contains channel details and a videos array. videoCount describes the channel total; it is not the length of the returned videos array.

title: YouTube Autocomplete
description: Expand a topic prefix with YouTube search suggestions for content planning. Defaults to language en and region US; suggestions are not search-volume measurements.
output: results[0] is an array of suggestion strings. An empty array means no suggestions were returned.

title: YouTube Cloud Storage
description: Deliver YouTube video or audio to your cloud storage, then inspect the asynchronous job and delivery manifest. Billed by delivered bytes; use media only with the rights your use requires.
output: Submit returns id, status and source. Read status returns lifecycle fields. Once completed, Read result returns a JSON manifest with file_url, file_size and delivered-byte metadata; private objects keep their storage access controls.
